notes: Neo Coolcam is the consumer camera brand of Shenzhen NEO Electronic Co., Ltd (the same maker behind the szneo brand_id). The official domains (neo-coolcam.com, neocoolcam.com) no longer resolve / are parked GoDaddy for-sale pages (checked 2026-09-10), and no support/download/FAQ/KB page publishes a user manual, datasheet, or CGI/API guide specifying a fixed RTSP URL path or port. The cameras are ONVIF-marketed consumer devices configured via the vendor mobile app (NEO@Home / iCSee-family) or ONVIF auto-discovery rather than a documented static RTSP URL. Every candidate path originates only from third-party aggregators and is heavily cross-brand contaminated (Dahua /cam/realmonitor, generic ipcam.sdp / ch0_0.h264). Per the no-guessing rule, no template is published. To integrate, use ONVIF discovery or the vendor app.
